name: Design change
description: Turn an authorized change request into an approved, reviewed, and actionable plan.

states.description: Read the repository instructions, current task, relevant source, and available external evidence.
Resolve the requested outcome, scope, constraints, authority, and open questions.
states.stopCondition: Stop when authority or scope cannot be resolved without a focused user decision.

states.description: Compare at least two plausible approaches against correctness, safety, scope, and maintenance constraints.
states.stopCondition: Stop when the available evidence cannot distinguish a safe approach.

states.description: Present the selected approach and obtain explicit approval before writing the specification.
states.stopCondition: Stop before specification changes when design approval is missing or withdrawn.

states.description: Write the smallest durable specification and review it against the approved scope and evidence.
states.stopCondition: Stop before planning when the specification is not consistent with the approved design.

states.description: Produce an executable plan with owned files, tests, gates, recovery, and verification evidence.
states.stopCondition: Stop successfully only when the approved specification has a bounded implementation plan.

gates.requirement: Repository instructions and relevant external evidence are recorded.
Scope, constraints, and authorization are explicit.
Plausible approaches and their trade-offs are recorded.
The user explicitly approves the selected design.
The specification matches the approved design and remains bounded.
The plan names scope, tests, gates, recovery, and verification evidence.

successCriteria: The approved design and reviewed specification are durable.
The plan is bounded, testable, and ready for implementation without skipping approval.
